headline: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands as leaders gather in China
detail: The three leaders met at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with trade, security and Ukraine on the agenda.

headline: India and Japan hold 2+2 defence and foreign ministers' dialogue
detail: Jaishankar said defence and security ties are key as India and Japan reviewed bilateral cooperation in Tokyo.

headline: Odisha evacuates 47,000 people as Cyclone Akvan nears the coast
detail: Akvan is forecast to cross between Narsapur and Puri around noon on Nov 20, with winds of 90-100 km/h.

headline: Congress targets Modi government over inflation, seeks white paper
detail: India's opposition Congress demanded a white paper on rising prices from the Modi government.

headline: Three workers killed in collapse at NTPC project in Jharkhand
detail: Three workers died when an under-construction conveyor structure collapsed at an NTPC project site.

headline: White House pursues loan package of over $2bn for the Philippines
detail: The White House said the US and Philippines will pursue financing through Foreign Military Financing.

headline: EU governments greenlight Indonesia trade pact
detail: The EU Council approved a trade deal with Indonesia to cut tariffs, with provisional application set to begin soon.

headline: PV Sindhu returns to badminton's world top five after four years
detail: The double Olympic medallist climbed to world No. 5 in the BWF rankings, her first top-five place since 2022.

headline: Crimean Bridge attacked again and closed to traffic
detail: Crimea's Russian-appointed head said the bridge was attacked for the third time this week and damage is being assessed.

headline: Ukraine's European allies meet in Berlin in show of support
detail: The Coalition of the Willing met in Berlin with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner to discuss security guarantees for Kyiv.

headline: EU proposes 45 billion euro Ukraine loan tied to reparations
detail: The European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine, to be repaid after Russia pays reparations.

headline: France sees fourth weekend of protests over rising living costs
detail: France faced a fourth consecutive weekend of nationwide demonstrations driven by anger over the cost of living.

headline: Estonia plans to close its border crossings with Russia in December
detail: Tallinn said crossings will close from December after an attempted attack on a defence company.

headline: Ukrainian-German entrepreneur charged with spying for Russia
detail: Federal prosecutors charged Ilona W. with allegedly acting as an informant for Russian intelligence in Berlin.

headline: Russia and Ukraine exchange drone attacks amid Abu Dhabi talks
detail: Both sides reported drone attacks damaging infrastructure, despite ongoing peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

headline: ESA chief calls for space laws and satellite surveillance rules
detail: The European Space Agency's chief called for new space laws and stronger satellite surveillance.

headline: Israeli military launches rare ground operation beyond Yellow Line
detail: Israeli tanks advanced across the Gaza cease-fire line in a rare incursion beyond the Yellow Line.

headline: Four nations urge Israel to let aid reach flooded Gaza
detail: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK jointly called for immediate, unrestricted humanitarian access across Gaza.

headline: Israel's president taps Eisenkot to try to form next government
detail: President Herzog asked former army chief Gadi Eisenkot to attempt to form a government, bypassing Netanyahu.

headline: Saudi Arabia says danger has passed after Riyadh warning
detail: Civil Defence issued a warning for Riyadh then said danger had passed, as Houthis claimed strikes on the capital.

headline: Tanker struck in engine room near Strait of Hormuz, crew safe
detail: UKMTO reported a tanker hit by a projectile six nautical miles north of Khasab; all crew were reported safe.

headline: US sanctions three entities and three people over Hezbollah links
detail: OFAC sanctioned the Wa Ta'awanu Association and a network over alleged Hezbollah funding links.

headline: Yemeni forces pull back from Bab el-Mandeb to defend Aden
detail: Government forces withdrew from the strait area as Houthi forces seized Red Sea coastal positions, a roundup reported.

headline: House Democrats nominate Jeffries, in line to be first Black Speaker
detail: Democrats voted 251 to 11 to nominate Hakeem Jeffries, putting him in line to become the first Black House Speaker.

headline: US senators warn AI-enabled cyber threats are outpacing defences
detail: Senators Cantwell and Rounds urged the White House AI czar to fix vulnerabilities as AI speeds up cyberattacks.

headline: Lawmakers demand briefings on string of US technology outages
detail: Both parties pressed for answers on outages hitting banks, airlines and agencies; the DNI said no coordinated attack was indicated.

headline: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for $1.4tn-plus stock market debut
detail: Anthropic began its Nasdaq debut day with a valuation above $1.4 trillion, among the largest listings ever.

headline: Van Gogh sells for record $190.4m after Nazi-history row settled
detail: Sotheby's sold Blossoming Chestnut Trees for $190.4 million in New York, a record for the artist, after an eleventh-hour deal.

headline: Grand Theft Auto VI begins global rollout after 13-year wait
detail: Gamers worldwide entered Vice City as GTA VI, the first new entry in the series in 13 years, launched globally.

headline: NTSB: helicopter flew dangerously low before Biscayne Bay crash
detail: Investigators reported the helicopter flew dangerously low before crashing in Biscayne Bay, Florida.

headline: NASA's Voyager 1 believed to have reached one light-day from Earth
detail: The 1977 probe is believed to be the first human-made object a full light-day from Earth, nearly five decades on.

headline: US and Venezuela sign deal to re-establish military ties
detail: Defence Secretary Hegseth announced the pact in Caracas, covering training, equipment and intelligence sharing.

headline: US details $12bn in Venezuelan oil and mineral revenue in report
detail: The State Department published a 53-page report on how over $12bn in Venezuelan oil and mineral revenue was handled.

headline: Panama announces second arrest over attack on journalist's home
detail: Prosecutors said a second suspect was apprehended in the attack on journalist Rolando Rodriguez's home.

headline: Paraguay extends Ueno Bank deposit guarantee deadline to December 2
detail: The central bank extended the statutory assessment period by 15 days while Ueno Bank's assets are reviewed.

headline: Ecuadorian fishermen sue Trump administration over boat strike
detail: The fishermen allege US drones illegally struck their boat in the eastern Pacific, in a US federal lawsuit.

headline: Kenya senator dismisses Ruto's State address as rights cover-up
detail: Senator Sifuna dismissed President Ruto's State of the Nation address as a cover-up for rights abuses.

headline: Firm to build geothermal-powered fertiliser plant at Olkaria
detail: A firm will build a geothermal-powered fertiliser plant at Kenya's Olkaria Energy Park, The Standard reported.

headline: UAE accuses Somalia's president of putting personal interests first
detail: UAE adviser Anwar Gargash accused President Hassan Sheikh of personal calculations amid a dispute over his mandate.

headline: Somalia gives $11.5m to 17,300 herders to save livestock in drought
detail: Over 17,300 pastoralists received support under the DRIVE programme to buy water and feed as drought worsens.

headline: Nigerian army admits dialogue with terrorists in Kwara State
detail: The army commented on a viral video and admitted dialogue with terrorists in Kwara, Premium Times reported.

headline: Ghana's new 10-cedi note features Justice Annie Ruth Jiagge
detail: Ghana's new GHc10 note honours Justice Annie Ruth Jiagge, 3News reported from Accra.

headline: Egypt and Syria to restore direct flights after 14 years
detail: Egypt and Syria will restore direct flights after a 14-year gap, Egyptian Streets reported.

headline: Cocaine and millions of pills seized in eastern Libya, officials say
detail: Libyan officials said cocaine and millions of pills were seized in the east of the country.

headline: Zimbabwe court reserves judgment on Mnangagwa term challenges
detail: The Constitutional Court reserved judgment on two challenges to President Mnangagwa's term extension.

headline: New Zealand reach 140/5 at tea on day one of India Test
detail: Bumrah took three wickets before Nicholls and Phillips rebuilt for New Zealand at Wellington's Basin Reserve.

headline: Port of Darwin lease row reignites ahead of Albanese-Xi meeting
detail: Leaseholder Landbridge refused to rule out tribunal action as Australia pursues ending the Port of Darwin lease.

headline: General Pants Co enters voluntary administration in Australia
detail: The retailer entered voluntary administration as Australia's retail sector faces continued strain.

headline: Australia backs more PNG skilled workers under PALM scheme
detail: Australia backed raising PNG workers under the PALM scheme toward 8,000 after the Port Moresby leaders' dialogue.
